The people using your app: find them, see what they bought and can use, explain their access, grant
and revoke perks by hand, edit them, and erase their data.

A person is named by their email, their distinct id (the id your app identifies them by) or their
id. Names and parts of an email cannot be searched. Prefix email:, distinct_id: or person_id: to say
which one you mean.

Usage:
  voidhash person <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  person, persons

Commands:
  list       List the project's newest persons.
  find       Find persons by their exact email, distinct id or id.
  view       Show a person: their profile, access, subscriptions, purchases, flag overrides and
             recent events.
  why        Explain why a person has or lacks a perk.
  edit       Change a person's email, name or attributes.
  create     Add a person before your app has seen them.
  grant      Give a person a perk without a purchase.
  revoke     Take back a perk a person was granted by hand.
  erase      Erase a person's personal data for good, for a data deletion request.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash person <command> --help' for more about a command.
